method: Native WCASL2 UI observations manually transcribed from screenshots; disk bytes captured separately by capture_native_file.py. No process-memory extraction.
input_limitations: Only the first IN of each newly opened stream is tested here; post-NUL subsequent stream position remains untested.
Immediate screenshots can precede repaint; the first-NUL and first-Ctrl+Z evidence was refreshed before transcribing values.

cmk_cases.condition: CASL files exist only alongside the cmk, not at stored absolute paths.
Open other/change-directory.cas through file dialog, activate still-open relative cmk, then assemble.

process_exit_limitations: No Windows crash dump, exit code or exception record obtained. Process/window disappearance verified separately; event log access denied. Original caller probe demonstrates fopen failure passed to fgetc(NULL).
